images.description: Muscular man gym workout dark - Used for Hero Section background or split
Healthy meal prep nutrition - Used for Nutrition Pillar card
Man sleeping dark bedroom - Used for Sleep Pillar card

sections.name: Urgency Bar
sections.instructions: Use react-fast-marquee. Background #F97316 (orange-500). Text is Black, uppercase, font-bold. '🔥 PROMO EARLY BIRD: HANYA RP 275.000 (DARI RP 950.000) • SLOT TERBATAS 🔥'. Make it fast and kinetic.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.instructions: Glassmorphism nav (bg-[#111111]/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Logo text '3 PILLAR MUSCLE' in white Poppins. Links: Pilar, Hasil, Harga, FAQ. CTA Button: 'DAFTAR' (orange, small). smooth scroll to sections.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.instructions: Use 'hero_bg' image. Left align content. H1: 'BANGUN OTOT. HANCURKAN LEMAK. TANPA ALASAN.' with Poppins Black. Subtitle: 'Sistem 3 pilar yang dirancang khusus untuk pemula gym di Indonesia.'. Primary CTA: 'AMBIL PROMO RP 275.000 SEKARANG'. Ensure text contrast with heavy black-to-transparent gradient overlay.

sections.name: Hook (Pain Points)
sections.instructions: H2: 'Sudah berbulan-bulan ke gym tapi badan tidak berubah?'. Grid of 3 cards. Dark cards (#1A1A1A) with 1px border border-white/10. Use red/orange accents. Pain points: 1. Latihan Asal-asalan (Tidak ada program), 2. Nutrisi Berantakan (Makan sembarangan), 3. Kurang Istirahat (Otot tidak berkembang).

sections.name: Storytelling
sections.instructions: Personal transformation story. 'Dulu saya persis seperti Anda...'. Use large quote formatting. High contrast text. Focus on the emotional shift from frustration to clarity.

sections.name: The 3 Pillars
sections.instructions: H2: '3 Pilar Pembentuk Otot'. Layout: 3 cards side by side. Each card has an image at the top (aspect-video) and text below. Card 1: 'TRAINING' (Use an icon or dark generic gym img). Card 2: 'NUTRITION' (Use nutrition_pillar image). Card 3: 'SLEEP' (Use sleep_pillar image). High contrast, technical borders.

sections.name: Social Proof (Before/After)
sections.instructions: H2: 'Hasil Nyata'. Display 'before_photo' and 'after_photo' in a stark, high-contrast layout. Don't use a slider, use a direct side-by-side split in a large card to emphasize the stark contrast. Add 'SEBELUM' and 'SESUDAH' labels.

sections.name: Value Stack Table
sections.instructions: H2: 'Apa yang Anda Dapatkan'. Create a technical-looking table (border-collapse, visible grid lines). List items (e.g., Program Latihan 12 Minggu, Panduan Meal Prep, dll) with their individual values (e.g., Rp 400.000). Show Total Value crossed out (Rp 950.000). Highlight 'HANYA RP 275.000'.

sections.name: Pricing / CTA
sections.instructions: A highly focused pricing card. Give it a glowing 1px orange border (simulating the tracing beam effect). Price: 'Rp 275.000'. Huge CTA Button 'GABUNG SEKARANG'. Underneath CTA, add trust badges/guarantee text.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.instructions: Use Shadcn Accordion. Customize to have no soft shadows. Sharp borders, bg-[#1A1A1A], hover state adds left orange border (border-l-4 border-l-orange-500).

technical_requirements.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (highly recommended for tactical/performance look)
technical_requirements.styling: Tailwind CSS + Shadcn UI (Customized for dark/tactical theme)
technical_requirements.animations: Framer motion for scroll reveals, react-fast-marquee for urgency bar
